rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for something continuing or enduring over a period of time.

example.english: The rain will last all afternoon.
example.traditional: 呢場雨會持續成個下晝。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 wui5 ci4 zuk6 sing4 go3 haa6 zau3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for referring to the most recent occasion.

example.english: The last time I went to Osaka, it was winter.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng6 ci3 heoi3 daai6 baan2 hai6 dung1 tin1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose calendar-time pattern, as in 上年, 上個月, or 上個星期二; 個 is included where natural.

example.english: I last saw him on Tuesday.
example.traditional: 我上個星期二先見過佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng6 go3 sing1 kei4 ji6 sin1 gin3 gwo3 keoi5

rows.note: Use 上次 as the all-purpose choice for the immediately previous occasion or occurrence, rather than for a named calendar period.

example.english: Last time we ate, you paid.
example.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 sik6 faan6 hai6 nei5 ceng2 haak3

rows.note: Use this for the one immediately preceding the current one, especially an item, turn, or example, rather than an occasion or date.

example.jyutping: soeng6 jat1 go3 lai6 zi2 bei2 gaau3 gaan2 daan1

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong expression specifically for the immediately preceding year.

example.jyutping: gau6 nin4 ngo5 bun1 zo2 uk1

rows.note: Use this for doing something finally or at the end of a process.

example.english: I understood at last that I was the one who had made a mistake.
example.traditional: 我最後先明白原來係我搞錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 ming4 baak6 jyun4 loi4 hai6 ngo5 gaau2 co3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when someone or something is last in an order or sequence.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 mei5 sin1 dou3
